sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Emergencies, Crashes, Law Enforcement
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Emergencies, Crashes, Law Enforcement

FACT_ID: sec17-R01 | anchor: A01
Flats hold straight and coast off-road, while front blows demand no overcorrection [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint failures; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec17-F02 and sec17-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec17-R02 | anchor: A01
Dark lamps retry switches and beams before flashing and exiting, while stalls muscle heavy controls roadside [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint failures; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec17-F04 and sec17-F05.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec17-R03 | anchor: A01
Stuck throttles snap neutral before stopping and killing engines, while key yanks lock wheels entirely [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint failures; prereq_hint sec17-F05; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec17-F06 and sec17-F07.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec17-R04 | anchor: A01
Dead brakes pump, then drag parking brakes skid-ready, then downshift off-road for good [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint failures; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec17-F08 and sec17-F09.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec17-R05 | anchor: A02
Safety triages first with lanes cleared and cars stilled, while 911 takes injuries and places [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint crash; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec17-F10 and sec17-F12.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec17-R06 | anchor: A02
Injury, death, or $1,500 damage compels reports within 72 hours, while officers take papers and insurers take briefs [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint crash; prereq_hint sec17-F12; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec17-F13 and sec17-F14.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec17-R07 | anchor: A03
Officer meetings stay calm and obedient, while autism and deaf flags prime smoother stops [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint enforcement; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec17-F16 and sec17-F17.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec17-R08 | anchor: A03
Signal stops pull clear of lanes into lots or side streets, while engines die and hands show [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint enforcement; prereq_hint sec17-F16; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec17-F18 and sec17-F19.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec17-R09 | anchor: A03
When a law-enforcement vehicle signals you to stop, carefully move into a clear area when safe, away from the travel lane. Shut off the vehicle, keep your hands in sight, preferably on the steering wheel, and remain calm while following the officer's directions. [A03]
Why it matters: group_hint enforcement; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec17-F19.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0064]
